summary: A direct call to onQueueWithdrawal by an arbitrary EOA consumes a victim's one-time provider voucher and makes the victim's later (delayed) withdrawal or deposit revert, but only with a stateful short-TTL provider plus a delay past the TTL; the missing hooked-market check is the enabler for known lenders, though the market's onTransfer path can also reach providers for unknown recipients (without harming them).
